Both Bitaxe orders went out, Jeff. They shipped October 19 and were delivered in (address hidden) on October 20, tracking ···· and (number hidden). I'm sorry, that left while your cancellation was still open.

Yes, they can go back, and so can the two faulty NerdQaxe++ units. The return approval and the prepaid labels need a person to sign off, and the team is offline until Monday at 10am ET. All four are in front of them, and the answer comes to (email hidden), so you don't need to wait here.

Understood, Jeff, just the two NerdQaxe++ units from Shop···· and Shop····. I've narrowed it to those, the Bitaxes stay with you.

Both are logged as hardware faults with Hal's findings and your photos. The return sign-off and the prepaid labels are the one piece I can't do myself, and the team picks that up Monday at 10am ET. The label and the return reference come to (email hidden), and I'll post them here too.

Nothing to send until that lands. Keep both unplugged.

Got it, Jeff. Both NerdQaxe++ units are set for return, nothing else touched.

Monday the sign-off goes through and the label plus the return reference come to (email hidden), and I'll post them here as well. Write the reference on the outside of the box when you pack them.

One thing I'd like to understand, since you've had two of the same board fail: were they both running on the same circuit or power strip at home?

Good to know, thanks Jeff. Two separate circuits points at the boards rather than your wiring, and that's noted on the return.

Nothing more needed from you. Monday brings the label and the reference to your email, and I'll put them here too.
I had them at two different locations

That's useful, two buildings and the same failure really does point at the boards.

One thing it changes: the return labels are cut from one address. Are both units with you now at the Durham address, so they can go back in one box? If one is still at the other location, give me that address and I'll get a second label set up for it.
Yes one label will be fine

Perfect, one box it is, both units from Durham.

Monday the return is signed off and the prepaid label comes to (email hidden) with the reference to write on the box. I'll post it here as well so you have it either way.

Pack both boards with their supplies, and keep the tracking once you drop it off.

All set then, Jeff. Both NerdQaxe++ units, one box, one label, out of Durham.

A copy of this conversation goes to your email once we're done here, so you'll have it in writing.
Good stuff, Jeff. Have a decent weekend, and if anything else comes up on your units, just write here.
You're welcome, Jeff. Take care, and I'll be back here Monday with the label.
Monday it is, Jeff. Enjoy the weekend.
